text_block_list.text:
One evening, while passing through the 
shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh? It's quite noisy. I wonder what 
happened.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, a lottery raffle? Sounds like fun!

The destination for the grand prize "Hot 
Spring Trip Voucher" is an illustrious hot 
spring that's normally well out of reach.

As I was wondering if there was a gift I 
could give to Fuji Kiseki, who's always 
working so hard—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Want to give it a try, Trainer? I actually 
had a raffle ticket on me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Since you're here, go ahead.

"Still... raffle tickets are just free 
bonuses with purchases. I really do feel a 
bit bad accepting them."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. I don't really mind, but... If 
that's the case—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Let's draw together! Think of it as 
testing both of our luck. How's that 
sound?"

And so... Timing our breaths together, we 
turned the raffle wheel's crank!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: G-Grand prize...!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I was so shocked! I never actually 
expected to pull the 'Hot Springs Vacation 
Voucher.'

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Looks like luck is on our side. Heheh.

All in all, I want Fuji Kiseki to make use 
of this travel voucher. When I handed over 
the voucher――

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: For me? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As for me, well... I'd really love it if 
you took the time to soothe your fatigue, 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: Go on and go with your close friend.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, is that so? Got it. Thank you."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Then... Trainer, would you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I tell you to go with someone close 
to you? Well, there you go—Trainer's right 
here.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“...That is, if you don't mind. ...What do 
you think?”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's more like it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"—Though we're both a bit busy right now. 
Once we have some free time, let's make 
plans again."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll prepare the most amazing trip for 
you. Look forward to it, okay? ♪

And so, the promise to go on a hot springs 
trip with Fuji Kiseki was made.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, first prize! That's amazing! You did 
it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's really big, so... would you like to 
share it with me?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's lay out a feast and relax while 
watching our favorite DVD. I'm sure it'll 
be fun.

That night, while relishing the Special 
Carrot Hamburg Steak with Fuji Kiseki—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The hallmark of this play is how the 
lighthearted dialogue subtly reflects the 
social issues of the era.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In particular, the changing color of the 
ribbon worn by the protagonist sparked 
numerous theories—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Oops, sorry! I rambled on for too 
long. The curtain is about to rise."

It was a night where I caught a rare 
glimpse of her, staring at the screen in 
complete absorption.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Second prize, huh. You did it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Still... what should we do, can we finish 
it all? It might be a bit tough for just 
the two of us.”
choice_data_list:
Shall we share some with the girls at the 
dorm?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Nice. Everyone in our dorm eats a ton, so 
they're gonna love it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I know! Since I'm giving it, maybe I 
should make it delicious first?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Really? Thanks! That's a huge help.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, what should I make? Stew? 
Steak? Cake sounds nice too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, cooking together like this is 
somehow really fun.

Splitting up the tasks, the two of us 
whipped up a whole feast of carrot dishes.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That was so close! But... it's too early 
to be disappointed."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to cast some magic on this 
single carrot. Could you wait in the 
Trainer's Room for about an hour?

Waiting in the Trainer's Office as 
instructed—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting, Trainer. My magic is 
all ready to go.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —*Ahem*! Now then, feast your eyes!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Behold, the carrot's transformation of the 
century! 3, 2, 1—!

—And with that, Fuji Kiseki pulled out a 
piping-hot carrot omurice!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just kidding. Come on, eat up while 
it's still warm.

The carrot omurice Fuji Kiseki made was 
melt-in-your-mouth delicious.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Too bad... Guess luck just wasn't on my 
side today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to see a happy look on your 
face, but...

Together with Fuji Kiseki, I felt 
completely dejected……
